kit_page.name: move_kit
kit_page.summary: Walk actors in a straight line, along a group, or with a custom walk animation.

kit_row.help: Walk and Stop drive the actors selected in the list, or everyone (you, if the list is empty).
kit_row.keywords: who selected everyone sync all actors walkers
kit_row.label: Who

radio_group.name: scope_radio
radio_group.tool_tip: Who Walk / Stop drive: the actors selected in the list, or everyone (you, if the list is empty)

kit_row.help: Start the walk for the chosen actors along the straight path set below.
kit_row.label: Walk

kit_row.help: Stop the walk and release the actors back to their normal animation.
kit_row.label: Stop / Release

kit_row.help: Ground speed of the walk in metres per second. The walk animation is scaled to match, so feet do not slide.
kit_row.keywords: speed velocity pace metres per second
kit_row.label: Speed

slider.name: speed_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ground speed of the local walk (m/s)

kit_row.help: How far each actor walks from its starting pose, in metres.
kit_row.label: Distance

kit_row.help: Travel direction relative to each actor's facing at the start. 0 is straight ahead.
kit_row.keywords: heading direction bearing angle turn compass
kit_row.label: Heading

spinner.name: heading_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Travel bearing relative to each actor's facing (deg). 0 = straight ahead

kit_row.help: Drag the needle or turn the wheel to trim the travel bearing relative to the actor's facing.
kit_row.keywords: heading compass dial bearing drag wheel
kit_row.label: Heading dial

compass_dial.name: move_heading_dial
compass_dial.tool_tip: Heading trim (deg): travel bearing relative to each actor's facing, 0 = straight ahead. Drag the needle; mouse wheel trims 5 deg per click. The in-world heading ray tracks it live

kit_row.help: What happens at the end of the walk: stop and settle, loop back to the start, or ping-pong back.
kit_row.keywords: end behavior loop ping-pong repeat stop
kit_row.label: End behavior

combo_box.name: end_mode_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: What happens when a walk reaches the end of its path

kit_row.help: Parameters are captured when a walk starts; walks already running keep theirs.
kit_row.label: Note
kit_row.text: Parameters are captured when a walk starts; running actors keep theirs.

kit_row.help: Ground speed the walk animation was designed for. Lower it if feet slide forward; raise it if they slide back.
kit_row.keywords: cadence stride foot slide nominal animation speed
kit_row.label: Cadence

slider.name: cadence_slider
slider.tool_tip: Ground speed the walk animation was designed for (m/s). Lower it if feet slide forward at slow speeds; raise if they slide back

kit_card.name: kc_custom_anim
kit_card.enable_tooltip: Play this animation asset instead of the system walk while moving (local playback only). Cadence stays the foot-plant tuning knob
kit_card.title: Custom walk anim

kit_row.help: Asset UUID of the walk animation. The Animation Explorer's To Actor Mover button fills this in.
kit_row.label: Anim UUID

line_editor.name: custom_anim_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: Animation asset UUID. Use the Animation Explorer's 'Send to Actor Mover' to fill this

kit_row.help: Client-side priority the custom walk plays at. Baked keeps the animation's own priority. Local to you.
kit_row.label: Priority

combo_box.name: custom_anim_priority_combo
combo_box.tool_tip: Client-side priority the custom walk plays at (local playback only; per-instance, so other avatars are unaffected). Baked keeps the animation's own priority. Higher wins over lower when animations overlap.

kit_row.help: The group that Start group and Stop group act on.
kit_row.label: Group

kit_row.help: Delay before each member of the selected group starts, to stagger the starts. 0 starts at once. Saved with the scene.
kit_row.label: Delay (s)

spinner.name: group_delay_spinner
spinner.tool_tip: Start delay for the selected group (s): ACTION and Start group launch its members this many seconds late (staggered starts). 0 = immediate. Saved with the scene

kit_row.help: Start every member of the chosen group.
kit_row.keywords: start group crowd walk all members
kit_row.label: Start group

kit_row.help: Stop every member of the chosen group.
kit_row.label: Stop group

kit_row.help: Every group with its member count and start delay. Select one to highlight its members in the cast list.
kit_row.label: Groups

scroll_list.name: groups_list
scroll_list.tool_tip: Every group with its member count and start delay. Select a row to highlight its members in the cast list and load the delay / rename fields below

kit_row.help: New name for the selected group. Enter or Rename commits; renaming onto an existing group merges them.
kit_row.label: Rename to

line_editor.name: group_rename_editor
line_editor.tool_tip: New name for the selected group; Enter or Rename commits. Renaming onto an existing group merges them

kit_row.help: Rename the selected group to the name typed on the left. Retags every member.
kit_row.label: Rename

button.name: btn_group_rename
button.label: Rename
button.tool_tip: Rename the selected group to the name on the left (retags every member)

kit_row.help: Clear the selected group. Members are untagged but stay in the cast; the group's delay is dropped.
kit_row.label: Dissolve

button.name: btn_group_dissolve
button.label: Dissolve
button.tool_tip: Clear the selected group: every member is untagged (nobody is removed from the cast); its delay is dropped
